title: Org update: field notes & Qs — Sept 2026
content:
Context and purpose:
Quick capture of highlights, questions, and action items from the Sept 9 org-wide engineering update. Meant as a working notes doc for follow-ups; not exhaustive. We covered ops incidents, performance wins, roadmap nudges, and a few cross-org asks.

Attendees (approx):
- Platform + infra leads, serving-runtime, SRE, product-hosted-api, observability reps, a few reps from private-deployments and optimize.

1) Opening highlights (5 min)
- Exec recap: GTM preparing a Dedicated launch announcement for enterprise pipeline; expect partner rollouts after Oct 1.
- TL;DR: steady revenue uptick, hiring freeze lifted for infra roles (up to 4 ICs), renewed focus on latency SLOs at p95/p99.

2) Post-incident summary (SRE) (12 min)
- Incident on 2026-09-09 03:12 UTC — degraded KV cache invalidation caused 2x token cost and spike in p99 latency for ~28 minutes. Root cause: double-invalidation on a rare prefix eviction race when node 7 was drained during rolling deploy.
- Impact: ~7% of hosted API requests hit fallback logic; a subset saw degraded throughput. No customer data exposed.
- Remediation: hotfix deployed to throttle invalidations + added gating on drain path (PR #424).
- Follow-ups (owners): add a chaos test to simulate node drain/invalidation (SRE / serving-runtime) — due 2026-09-24; add metric alert for consecutive cache-invalidations > 3/min (observability) — due 2026-09-17.

3) Serving runtime progress (15 min)
- KV cache rewrite (lin-stage) status: on canary with internal traffic. Observed 14% token-cost reduction for short-chat workloads, 9% on long-form generation. Still seeing edge-case cold-start penalty on multi-turn sessions.
- Batcher improvements: adaptive batch sizing landed; p50 token generation latency unchanged, p95 improved ~6% in smaller regions (ap-south), but we need more synthetic tests at 100k qps.
- Action: run a 24h soak with synthetic multi-tenant workload (serving-runtime + infra) — owner: Marco; schedule window: Sept 21–22.

4) Private deployments update (8 min)
- VPC onboarding checklist: 3 customers in active integration; one flagged requirement for HSM integration. Engineering to provide HSM integration doc + reference architecture by Sept 20 (owner: Priya).
- On-prem package: small installer issue reported on RHEL 8 packaging; release build bumped, patch planned for Sept 16.

5) Console & Observability (10 min)
- New trace breakdown UI: initial beta looks good, but UX team wants to surface token-level cost by route. Observability team to prototype a token-cost overlay for the dashboard (Ruth + observability) — prototype due Oct 1.
- Tracing overhead: current instrumentation adds ~2% CPU to the hosting control plane; optimization spike requested to keep under 1%.

6) Product/roadmap notes (7 min)
- Hosted API: experiment on dynamic routing by cost tier is green in staging. Need sign-off on safety fallback ordering — product + research to finalize.
- Optimize: proof-of-concept quantization advisor demoed; initial results promising for BFloat->4-bit in non-critical paths. Follow-up: expand eval tests to customer prompts (privacy-safe) — owner: product-optimize.

7) Open floor Q&A (15 min) — notable threads
Q: "How will Dedicated capacity affect routing policies?"
A: Dedicated capacity will be treated as a higher-priority route with pinned model versions; policy table will prefer Dedicated when SLA tag exists, with automatic fallback to hosted variants if capacity exhausted. Implementation note: policy engine change planned in Oct; will require policy migration tooling.

Q: "Any action on cost transparency for customers?"
A: Yes — planned per-route token breakdown in Console + downloadable CSV. Initial rollout targeted for mid-Oct.

Q: "Is there a clear definition of what counts as a major regression for Optimize recommendations?"
A: Not yet; proposed thresholds: >5% accuracy drop on lumina evals OR >15% latency increase for p95 vs baseline. Product/research to finalize.

8) Cross-org asks and blockers (bulleted)
- Infra: need a dedicated GPU-node for stress testing (request sent to SRE infra capacity).
- Serving-runtime: want more annotated customer prompt sets for evals (privacy-scrubbed). Product to share 3 sanitized sets by Sept 18.
- Sales/legal: asking for a short one-pager about Private deploy compliance posture (SOC2 + KMS workflows) — owner: security-and-compliance + product.

9) Action items (owner + due date)
- Add chaos test for drain+cache invalidation (Marco, SRE) — due 2026-09-24.
- Metric alert for cache-invalidation spikes (Ruth, observability) — due 2026-09-17.
- KV cache cold-start profiling + mitigation plan (Lin, serving-runtime) — due 2026-09-30.
- Soak test for adaptive batcher at 100k qps (Marco + infra) — schedule Sept21–22.
- HSM integration reference arch + doc (Priya) — due 2026-09-20.
- RHEL packaging patch for on-prem installer (Oscar) — due 2026-09-16.
- Token-cost overlay prototype (Ruth + console) — due 2026-10-01.
- Quantization advisor expanded evals (product-optimize) — due 2026-10-05.

10) Parking lot / unresolved items
- Final SLO targets for p95 vs p99 for hosted API (product + SRE to present a proposal at next all-hands).
- Rollout strategy for Dedicated -> Hosted fallbacks (needs detailed runbook and automated migration tool).
- Long-term plan for tracing overhead vs fidelity trade-offs.

Notes to self / quick wins
- Encourage teams to add a brief "what success looks like" line to PR descriptions for infra changes — will make postmortems faster.
- Consider a recurring 30-min cross-team "latency war room" for the next 6 weeks while KV cache rollout stabilizes.

References / links called out during meeting:
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/424 (cache invalidation throttle)
- Incident ticket: JIRA-INF-987
- Canaries & metrics: CONFLUENCE-ENG-7421

If you added items or changes, please append to the end of this doc and ping me (Aisha) in #platform-eng. I'll reconcile before next org update.

End of notes.
